ns2:section.sectionText: ****If interested, contact Carolynn Claussen at cc103@illinois.edu for an interview.*** Title: Performance Nutrition Experience with Illini Athletics and Illini Fuel.This 2-credit hour course provides students with an immersive, hands-on opportunity to work alongside Illini Athletics and the Illini Fuel program at the University of Illinois. Students will gain valuable experience in performance nutrition, contributing to the preparation, delivery, and management of athlete-focused nutritional support. Enrollment requires successfully passing an interview process followed by a background check conducted by the Department of Intercollegiate Athletics prior to the first week of class. Students will commit to ~6 hours per week (totaling 100 hours) over the semester, including early morning and late evening shifts. Attendance and participation are critical, with each 2-hour shift contributing 2% toward the final grade. Students must arrive on time with a positive "can-do" attitude and remain until formal dismissal to earn this credit. This course is ideal for students passionate about performance nutrition, seeking to develop practical skills and gain professional experience in a dynamic environment that directly supports athletic performance and recovery.
